title: Customer Onboarding
summary: End-to-end New-to-Bank customer onboarding from initiation and eligibility through customer data capture, identity verification, KYC/CDD, screening, approval, customer and account creation, activation, completion, and controlled exception handling across digital and assisted channels.

modules.title: Overview

payload.title: Business Context
payload.text: Customer Onboarding establishes a new customer relationship by capturing and validating customer information, completing identity and due-diligence activities, resolving required screening and risk checks, obtaining the required decision, creating or updating the authoritative customer record, creating the requested account or product, and completing activation. The journey can be initiated through digital self-service or assisted channels. The business objective is to provide a controlled, traceable and customer-friendly path without bypassing mandatory eligibility, KYC, screening, approval, evidence or operational controls.

payload.title: Purpose
payload.text: The CASA Onboarding domain covers the end-to-end process of enrolling a new or existing customer into a Current Account or Savings Account product. It supports digital and branch-assisted onboarding while embedding identity, compliance and operational controls.

payload.title: Objectives
rows: Acquire new retail and corporate customers through digital and branch channels.
Reduce time from application submission to account activation.
Embed KYC, AML and sanctions screening into onboarding.

payload.title: Journey Scope
rows: Customer expresses intent to become a customer or open an eligible product through a supported channel.
Marketing lead generation before onboarding initiation.
Eligibility, data and consent, identity, KYC/CDD, screening, risk, approval, customer creation, account/product creation, activation and exceptions.
Ongoing servicing, profile maintenance and post-onboarding product servicing.
Customer relationship and requested account/product reach a completed, rejected, cancelled or expired outcome.

Apply eligibility, identity, KYC/CDD, screening, risk and approval controls consistently.
Route non-STP cases to the correct operational, KYC, compliance or approval owner.
Maintain sufficient evidence and audit information to explain the onboarding decision.
Prevent incomplete or unresolved cases from being treated as successfully completed.

sections.title: General Business Process Flow

payload.title: Customer Onboarding – End-to-End General Business Process Flow
payload.description: BPMN-aligned business workflow covering New-to-Bank customer onboarding from initiation and eligibility through customer data capture, consent, duplicate checking, identity verification, KYC/CDD, screening, risk assessment, review and approval, customer and account creation, activation, completion, rework, rejection and operational exceptions.

scope.start: Customer expresses intent to establish a banking relationship or apply for an eligible banking product.
scope.successEnd: Customer and requested account/product are successfully created and onboarding reaches the required active or ready-for-use state.
alternateOutcomes: Existing customer routed to applicable existing-customer journey
outOfScope: Corporate KYB legal-entity onboarding unless separately modelled

businessRules.rule: Only an onboarding context supported by the applicable customer, product and channel policy may proceed.
A confirmed existing customer must not be unintentionally created as a duplicate customer master.
Required customer information and consent must be complete before dependent verification and due-diligence processing is finalized.
Only an accepted identity-verification outcome may proceed to final KYC/CDD and onboarding decision.
Required CDD, EDD, screening and customer-risk activities must reach the applicable resolved outcome before final approval.
Manual approval must be performed by an authorized role according to the applicable approval policy.
Customer and account creation must only occur after a valid onboarding approval.
Failed or uncertain creation responses must be reconciled before retry to prevent duplicate customer or account creation.
Onboarding must not be marked complete while required creation, activation or blocking exception conditions remain unresolved.

successOutcome.description: Customer onboarding is successfully completed after the customer and requested account/product have been created, required activation conditions have been satisfied, authoritative references have been stored, and completion evidence and customer notification have been finalized.

payload.text: Capture the customer information, declarations, acknowledgements and consent required to support identity verification, KYC/CDD, screening, risk assessment and downstream customer/account creation.

payload.title: Business Triggers
items: A reviewer requests missing or corrected information.

items: Onboarding application exists and is eligible.
Customer or assisted user is associated with the correct application.
Applicable data requirements are known for the onboarding context.

payload.title: Business Process

Validate mandatory fields, formats and consistency.
Persist progress and current business state.
Release completed data set to identity and KYC/CDD.

payload.title: Business Rules
rows: Required information must be determined from the onboarding context and policy.
Required consent/acknowledgement must be explicitly captured.
Updates must remain attributable to the correct application/user context.
Material declarations must not be silently defaulted where explicit response is required.

payload.title: Validation Rules
rows: Related values are not logically inconsistent.
Required consent/declarations are present and auditable.
Updates belong to the correct application/customer context.

payload.title: Decision Points
rows: Mandatory data set and captured values

payload.title: Outputs
items: Input package for identity and KYC/CDD

payload.title: Exceptions
rows: Return clear missing items to customer/assisted user.
Prevent dependent processing and request valid consent.
Preserve permitted progress and allow controlled resume.
Resume or expire according to policy.

payload.title: Responsibilities
rows: Determine requirements, persist progress and evaluate completeness.
Provide or receive customer context where applicable.

modules.summary: Capture complete, consistent and auditable customer information and consent.

modules.title: Identity & Document Verification

payload.title: Purpose
payload.text: Verify that the person being onboarded corresponds to the claimed identity and that required identity documents or evidence satisfy the bank's applicable onboarding policy.

payload.title: Business Triggers
items: Customer data is sufficiently complete for identity verification.
A previous verification attempt requires retry.
Manual verification is requested after an inconclusive automated outcome.

payload.title: Preconditions
items: Required identity attributes have been captured.
Required identity evidence is available where applicable.
Required consent for the verification method has been captured where applicable.

payload.title: Inputs
items: Document number and validity information where applicable

payload.title: Business Process
rows: Validate evidence completeness and basic document validity.
Verified, failed, inconclusive or manual review.
Compare verification result with captured customer data.
Record final result and evidence reference.

payload.title: Business Rules
rows: Required identity evidence must be available before verification is finalized.
Invalid, expired or unsupported evidence must not produce successful verification.
Material verified identity attributes must be consistent with the customer profile.
Only an accepted final verification outcome may advance downstream.

payload.title: Validation Rules
rows: Evidence is supported and valid according to policy.
Verified attributes do not materially conflict with captured data.

payload.title: Exceptions
rows: Apply permitted retry or manual review.
Pause downstream processing and resolve discrepancy.

payload.title: Responsibilities
rows: Capture evidence and show verification status.

modules.summary: Verify customer identity and required identity evidence before due diligence continues.

modules.title: KYC / Customer Due Diligence

payload.title: Purpose
payload.text: Establish and assess the customer due-diligence profile needed to understand the intended relationship and determine whether standard due diligence is complete or enhanced due diligence, additional evidence or escalation is required according to applicable bank policy and jurisdiction.

payload.title: Business Triggers
items: Identity verification reaches an acceptable state.
CDD information is incomplete or requires customer rework.
Risk/screening review requests additional due-diligence information.

payload.title: Preconditions
items: Customer identity and core profile are sufficiently established.
Required CDD questions for the onboarding context are known.
Applicable evidence requirements can be determined.

payload.title: Inputs
items: Other risk factors required by policy

payload.title: Business Process
rows: Capture or reuse permitted CDD information.
Determine whether additional due diligence is required.
Perform enhanced review/evidence collection where required.

payload.title: Business Rules
rows: CDD requirements may vary by customer, product, channel, jurisdiction and risk.
Required CDD data must be complete before finalization.
Cases meeting EDD criteria must follow the enhanced route.
Required supporting evidence references must be retained where policy requires them.

payload.title: Validation Rules
rows: KYC answers do not materially conflict with profile/evidence.
Required enhanced route is completed where applicable.
Required evidence is available where applicable.

payload.title: Outputs
items: Inputs for screening, risk and approval

payload.title: Exceptions
rows: Clarify conflicting information and retain resolution.
Collect enhanced information/evidence and route to review.

payload.title: Responsibilities

modules.summary: Complete customer due diligence and route enhanced-due-diligence cases where required.

modules.title: Screening & Risk Assessment

payload.title: Purpose
payload.text: Perform the customer screening and risk-assessment activities required by applicable bank policy, resolve potential matches or elevated-risk cases, and determine the risk-based route for onboarding.

payload.title: Business Triggers
items: Sufficient identity and CDD information is available.
A potential match requires compliance resolution.

payload.title: Preconditions
items: Required CDD data is complete enough for checks.

payload.title: Business Rules
rows: Required screening must reach a resolved outcome before final approval.
A potential match must not be treated as clear without authorized resolution.
Risk classification must use the approved methodology and available KYC information.
Required EDD/enhanced approval must complete before approval.
Final approval must not rely on unresolved mandatory screening.

payload.title: Validation Rules
rows: Required results are returned and interpretable.
Potential matches have final authorized resolution.

payload.title: Decision Points
rows: Clear / Potential match / Confirmed adverse / Error

payload.title: Exceptions
rows: Route to Compliance for authorized resolution.
Retry or route to controlled manual handling.

payload.title: Responsibilities
rows: Hold state until required outcomes resolve.

modules.summary: Resolve required screening and customer-risk outcomes before final onboarding approval.

modules.title: Review & Approval

payload.title: Purpose
payload.text: Determine whether the onboarding application has satisfied all mandatory business, KYC, screening, risk and evidence requirements and issue the appropriate approve, rework or reject decision using the applicable authority and workflow.

payload.title: Business Triggers
items: Identity, CDD, screening and risk stages have final/reviewable outcomes.
Manual review or approval is required.
A reworked application returns for decision.

payload.title: Preconditions
items: Mandatory upstream checks have acceptable resolved status.
Required evidence and decision inputs are available.
Required EDD/compliance resolution is complete or explicitly part of the decision package.

payload.title: Business Process
rows: Determine STP versus manual decision route.
Present decision package to authorized approver where required.
Approve, reject or request rework with controlled reason.

payload.title: Business Rules
rows: Approval must not occur while mandatory upstream conditions remain unresolved.
Manual approval must be performed by an authorized role.
Reject/rework outcomes must include an appropriate reason.
Decision must be traceable to inputs, review and authority.
Users must not bypass unresolved mandatory controls.

payload.title: Validation Rules
rows: Mandatory upstream outcomes are final and acceptable.

payload.title: Outputs
items: Approved creation instruction or rework/reject outcome

payload.title: Exceptions
rows: Record reason, stop creation and communicate outcome.
Return to identified stage with clear action.

modules.summary: Approve, rework or reject the onboarding application using the required authority and decision evidence.

modules.title: Customer & Account Creation

payload.title: Purpose
payload.text: Create or update the authoritative customer master and create the approved account/product using the approved onboarding decision while preventing duplicate records and preserving system-of-record references.

payload.title: Business Triggers
items: A prior creation attempt requires controlled retry/repair.

payload.title: Business Rules
rows: Creation occurs only for an approved application.
Do not create a second authoritative customer for a confirmed existing customer.
Returned authoritative references must be stored against onboarding context.
Retries must avoid duplicate customer/account creation.
Requested product/account must remain eligible at creation time.

payload.title: Exceptions
rows: Retry/repair using the same onboarding/correlation context.
Retry/repair without repeating successful customer creation unnecessarily.
Stop duplicate creation and reconcile handling.

payload.title: Responsibilities
rows: Submit approved creation instructions and persist references.
Create/update authoritative customer and account/product records.

modules.summary: Create the approved customer and account/product safely and persist authoritative references.

modules.title: Activation & Completion

payload.title: Purpose
payload.text: Complete the onboarding relationship after successful customer/account creation by confirming required activation conditions, finalizing onboarding evidence and status, communicating the outcome, and handing the customer into normal servicing.

payload.title: Business Triggers
items: Customer and required account/product creation succeeded.
A pending activation condition has been resolved.

payload.title: Business Process
rows: Confirm customer/account results and activation prerequisites.
Finalize evidence, references and completion status.
Hand off active relationship to normal servicing.

payload.title: Business Rules
rows: Do not mark complete while required creation/activation conditions remain unresolved.
Authoritative customer and account/product references must exist.
Customer-facing status must reflect authoritative outcome.
Required decision/creation/evidence references must remain associated with the application.

payload.title: Decision Points
rows: Creation results, activation prerequisites and exceptions

payload.title: Exceptions
rows: Keep pending and request/perform required action.
Retain business completion and retry communication separately.
Reconcile onboarding with system of record.

payload.title: Responsibilities
rows: Determine completion readiness and final state.

modules.summary: Confirm activation and complete onboarding with accurate status, evidence and communication.

modules.title: Exception & Rework

payload.title: Purpose
payload.text: Provide a controlled mechanism for onboarding cases that cannot remain on the straight-through path. Each exception should identify the trigger, accountable owner, required action, return point and final outcome without bypassing mandatory controls.

payload.title: Exception Catalogue
rows: Validate match and decide reuse/update/new handling.
Existing path, confirmed new or reject.
Retry where permitted or manual verification.
Open compliance review and block final approval.
Collect additional information/evidence and enhanced review.
Record reason, stop creation and notify.
Core creation fails or result uncertain.
Reconcile, retry, repair or return for product decision.
Expire and require restart/resume according to policy.
Retry or route to controlled manual handling.
Hold completion and return to relevant control stage.

payload.title: Rework Routing
rows: Correct profile or provide acceptable evidence.

payload.title: Exception Control Principles
items: Every exception has an accountable owner and visible business state.
Rework returns to the stage that owns the failed business condition.
Technical retry must not duplicate an already-created customer or account.
Potential compliance or identity issues remain unresolved until an authorized outcome exists.
Rejected, cancelled and expired applications cannot continue to creation/activation.
Customer-facing status distinguishes pending action, rework, rejection and completed onboarding.

modules.summary: Controlled rework, operational exceptions, rejection, cancellation and expiry.

modules.title: Business Analysis

payload.title: Business Rule Catalogue
rows: Onboarding context must be supported for the selected customer/product/channel before detailed onboarding proceeds.
A confirmed existing customer must not be unintentionally created as a second customer master.
All required information must be complete before dependent stages finalize.
Required declarations and consent must be explicitly captured before dependent processing completes.
Only an accepted final identity-verification outcome may advance the case.
Unsupported, invalid or expired identity evidence must not produce successful verification.
Required KYC/CDD information and evidence must be complete before finalization.
Cases meeting EDD criteria must complete the required enhanced route before final approval.
Mandatory screening results must be resolved before final onboarding approval.
Customer risk classification must use the applicable approved methodology and available KYC information.
Manual approval must be performed by an authorized role after mandatory prerequisites are satisfied.
Final approve/reject/rework outcomes must retain reason, authority and evidence references.
Customer creation occurs only after approval and duplicate conditions are resolved.
Account/product creation occurs only when approved product remains eligible and customer reference exists.
Operational retries must not intentionally duplicate a customer or account that may already exist.
Onboarding must not be marked complete until required creation and activation conditions are satisfied.
Incomplete applications may expire/cancel according to applicable completion policy.
Manual/UI actions must not bypass unresolved mandatory identity, CDD, screening, risk or approval conditions.

payload.title: Validation Catalogue
rows: Required consent exists and is auditable.
Supported and valid according to policy.
Required enhanced route completed where applicable.

payload.title: Data Entities
rows: Tracks request, current state, stages, decisions and references.
Due-diligence information, completeness and enhanced-review requirements.
Customer risk classification and supporting outcome.
Requested banking product/account and authoritative reference.
Manual review, repair or unresolved exception.
Key actions, changes, decisions and outcomes.

payload.title: System Responsibility Matrix
rows: Customer interaction, data capture, consent, status and next action.
Not automatically the system of record.
Not assumed to perform KYC or core account creation.
No specific regulatory model beyond applicable policy.
Manual task assignment and exception workflow where used.
Not mandatory if equivalent capability exists.
Trace key changes, decisions, evidence and outcomes.

payload.title: Risks and Controls
rows: Require appropriate identity evidence, verification and controlled resolution before continuation.
Apply mandatory-data, consistency, rework and evidence requirements.
Prevent dependent processing until required consent/declarations are valid and auditable.
Perform customer matching and controlled reuse/update/manual resolution.
Prevent final approval until required screening has an authorized resolved outcome.
Use approved methodology, complete KYC inputs and required review/EDD routes.
Enforce approval authority and workflow permissions.
Require reason, authority and evidence references.
Persist and reconcile authoritative references before completion.
Derive status from authoritative outcomes and unresolved exceptions.

rows: Customer created and account creation submitted.

payload.title: BA Discovery Questions
items: What marks the start and end of Customer Onboarding for each supported product and customer segment?
Which customer types, products, jurisdictions and channels are eligible for straight-through onboarding?
Which customer data fields are mandatory by context, and which system owns each value after onboarding?
What declarations and consent are required and what evidence must be retained?
How is an existing or duplicate customer identified and resolved?
Which identity verification methods and document types are supported by channel/customer context?
Which KYC/CDD questions and evidence vary by product, customer, jurisdiction or risk?
What conditions trigger enhanced due diligence?
Which screening checks are mandatory and who owns potential-match resolution?
How is customer risk classified and which inputs drive that classification?
Which cases qualify for STP versus manual review?
Who may approve, reject or request rework and what authority limits apply?
What conditions must be satisfied before customer master creation?
How are customer/account creation retries made safe when downstream result is delayed or uncertain?
Which system is the source of truth for customer, account, KYC, screening, risk and onboarding state?
What business states are visible to customers versus internal users?
Who owns each exception and where does the case return after rework?
What audit evidence is required for each major decision and control?
When is an incomplete application cancelled or expired and can it be resumed?
What communications are required for pending action, rejection and successful completion?

payload.title: BA Outputs
items: Business State Model and State Transition Matrix
Integration / API Requirements where separately evidenced
Happy-path, alternate-path and exception Test Scenarios
